name: fx 40.0.2
body:
## Fixes

- A `__proto__` key in JSON input is now kept as a regular field instead of being dropped, and `walk` and `sortKeys` keep it too (#449). Thanks @anishpentyala for the report!
- `groupBy` no longer drops items whose group is `__proto__` (#448). Thanks @yuxino!
- Block comments ending in `**/` now close correctly (#445). Thanks @HoneyPaptan!
- `zip()` with no inputs returns `[]` instead of looping forever (#442). Thanks @nk-batman21!
- Errors in YAML, TOML or XML input are printed to stderr instead of stdout (#441). Thanks @jdotc1!
- Arrays with holes keep their indexes in output: `[1, , 3]` prints as `[1,null,3]` (#443). Thanks @nk-batman21!
